findings.evidence: Lines 317-319, 60-61, 342-343 vs. the statements at 320-322 and 344-348; `TauCeti/Geometry/Symplectic/Manifold/AlmostComplex.lean:21-23` states tameness/compatibility exist only pointwise, so no manifold-level hypothesis is discharged.
findings.fix: Scope the claims to the linear layer: e.g. "so the pointwise compatibility hypothesis on a symplectic vector space is satisfiable; the smooth fibrewise statement is not proved here". Drop the Lane F3/F4 and "Lagrangian Floer homology" non-vacuity claims or restrict them to Lagrangian subspaces of a symplectic vector space.
findings.issue: Overclaim: `exists_compatible`'s docstring says "the tameness and compatibility hypotheses used throughout the analytic Heegaard Floer roadmap are never vacuous". The statement is purely linear (one finite-dimensional real vector space, arbitrary choices of x and y, no continuity), so it gives nothing about the manifold-level hypotheses of the roadmap — nearly-symmetric `J` and the taming form on `Sym^g(Σ)` (roadmap `HeegaardFloer/README.md:227,231`), which need a smooth/fibrewise choice. The PR description itself concedes that "the corresponding fibrewise existence statement" remains. Same overclaim at lines 60-61 ("the totally real boundary conditions of Lanes F3 and F4 are never vacuous") and 342-343 ("the totally real boundary conditions of Lagrangian Floer homology are never vacuous").

findings.evidence: grep: `Compatible` hits at StandardCompatible.lean:124-127, Cotangent/Compatible.lean:135-138, Complex/Line.lean:126.
findings.fix: Replace with the accurate statement: witnesses existed only for the standard form and its transports; no result covered an arbitrary symplectic form on an arbitrary finite-dimensional real space.
findings.issue: Module docstring is inaccurate about the prior state: "until now nothing said that they can be met: `TauCeti.stdSymplecticForm` exhibits one compatible triple". The repository already had at least three named compatible pairs: `stdSymplecticForm_compatible_product` (StandardCompatible.lean:124), `cotangentSymplecticForm_compatible_almostComplexStructure` (Cotangent/Compatible.lean:135), and the compatible pair on `ℂ` (Complex/Line.lean:126).

findings.fix: Cut both clauses: state "A finite-dimensional symplectic vector space has even dimension." and, for the subsingleton lemma, drop the induction remark.
findings.issue: Docstrings describing the proof rather than the result: `even_finrank`'s "a compatible almost complex structure makes it a complex vector space" is a proof sketch, and it misattributes the reason to compatibility (any almost complex structure forces even rank; compatibility is only used to obtain one). Same at line 277, where `exists_compatible_of_subsingleton` says "This is the base of the induction", referring to the private `exists_compatible_aux` that users cannot see.

summary: The declarations are documented, but three docstrings promise non-vacuity of the roadmap's manifold-level tameness/totally-real hypotheses, which a purely linear existence statement does not deliver; the module opening also misstates the prior state of the repository, and two docstrings describe the proof rather than the result.
